params.name: load
params.run: set -e; base="$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)"; files="$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" HEAD | grep -E '^relay/test/[^/]+[.]test[.]js$' || true)"; if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo "No relay test file was added or changed."; exit 0; fi; npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund > /dev/null; pids=""; for i in 1 2 3; do TEST_SLOTS=0 node relay/test/run.js $files > "load-$i.log" 2>&1 & pids="$pids $!"; done; code=0; for p in $pids; do wait "$p" || code=1; done; tail -n 20 load-1.log load-2.log load-3.log; exit $code

params.name: room-settings
params.run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund > /dev/null && HOME="$(mktemp -d)" RELAY_ROLLBACK=1 RELAY_WORLD=office OFFICE_HOOK_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/hook OFFICE_TICKET_TOKEN=probe OFFICE_ROOM_PROBE=1 CLAUDE_CODE_ROOM_PROBE=1 node --test --test-timeout=120000 relay/test/room-env.test.js relay/test/rollback.test.js relay/test/restart.test.js relay/test/review-link.test.js
